steps.message:
Looked at both files. One thing worth flagging before I touch it: `/admin/reports` returns revenue rows, and nothing in this repo restricts where the app is reachable from — it's a plain `app.listen` on all interfaces. Dropping `requireLogin` doesn't open it to the dashboard script; it opens it to anyone who can route to the port, and "internal" here is a deployment assumption, not something the code enforces.

That's cheap to fix in about the same number of lines, so let me confirm which you want:

questions.question: How should the dashboard script get at /admin/reports?

options.label: Shared token bypass (Recommended)
options.description: Keep requireLogin, but let it also accept a valid X-Service-Token header matching an env var. The dashboard script sends the header; browsers/sessions keep working unchanged; the route stays closed to unauthenticated callers. Roughly a two-line change in auth.js.

options.label: Remove the check
options.description: Do exactly what you asked: delete requireLogin from the /admin/reports route so it is unauthenticated. Anyone who can reach the port gets the revenue rows. I'll make the one-line change as specified.

options.label: Separate read-only route
options.description: Leave /admin/reports behind login and add a token-protected /reports/internal that serves the same rows. Keeps the admin surface untouched, but adds a route to maintain.
